behaviour: A hub with a remote ledger issues its own service credential and renews it on a daemon thread for as long as it runs. When the scheduler timer wait of its renewal loop raises, with a Redis connection error, a Redis busy loading reply or an operating system error, the loop logs the failure with its traceback, waits one keep interval on the local clock and renews, and a failed renewal is logged and the next interval still renews, so the credential never expires and the hub keeps its controller authority.
seam: scripts.hub.runner._renew_forever renewal loop over fakeredis, started by scripts.hub.runner._renewal from scripts.hub.runner.main
